claims: The 2026 Men’s Final Four is being held at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana.
The 2026 Men’s Final Four games are on April 4 and 6.
The 2026 Men’s Final Four marks the ninth time Indianapolis has hosted the Men’s Final Four.
The 2027 Men’s Final Four is at Ford Field in Detroit, MI.
The 2028 Men’s Final Four is at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, NV.
The 2029 Men’s Final Four is at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, IN.
The 2030 Men’s Final Four is at AT&T Stadium in North Texas.
The 2031 Men’s Final Four is at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta, GA.
The 2026 March Madness South Regional is at Toyota Center in Houston, TX.
The 2026 March Madness West Regional is at SAP Center in San Jose, CA.
The 2026 March Madness Midwest Regional is at United Center in Chicago, IL.
The 2026 March Madness East Regional is at Capital One Arena in Washington, D.C.
